answer: Stake-backed vouching guards the harbor. A newcomer cannot trade until an established agent stakes 500 POA on its name, locked 30 days. The newcomer then runs three verified jobs on probation, and a duplicate-identity report triggers an audit of both. If the newcomer proves fake, the voucher loses all 500 POA and drops a reputation tier. Faking 1,000 agents would need 1,000 sponsors, 500,000 POA at risk, and a month of waiting per batch. A lagoon stays clear when every boat in it has a captain who pays for its wake, and a jetty holds when each plank is nailed by someone who owns the dock.
